title: Baby-G Women Digital Watch BG-169GD-1DR
description:
Revisit the 1990s to 2000s rock scene with a BABY-G that is all about the grunge aesthetic.
We start with the distinctive compact round form and front protectors of the BG-169 and add a gradation of faded, gray hues that brings non-fashion to life. A refined rethink on a nostalgic vibe, the matte-finished bezel and band project laid-back subtlety.
With practical functionality like durable shock-resistant construction, 200-meter water resistance, world time, stopwatch and more, this versatile watch works with any style, whether you’re just chilling or taking on the world.
